node.title: Re: mysteries of regex substring matching
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
So, is there a way to use capture groups to match multiple times like separate groups does inthe first example?

Not really (Update: at least within a single regex, [LanX] already [id://11126980|showed] /g), unless you mess around with some of the more advanced regex features like maybe (?{})/(??{}). But before going down that route, this feels like an [XY Problem] to me; for example, for the task you show, [doc://unpack] may be better, e.g. unpack("(A4)4A*","AAD34017837201D98AAED18778DEF993")

Minor edits.
